title: Really Simple AI Risk Framework (RSAIRF)
description: The Really Simple AI Risk Framework (RSAIRF) is a lightweight, practical framework for identifying, scoring, and tracking the risks that arise when organizations build, deploy, or use AI. At its core is a curated register of 30 AI-specific risks, each mapped to the lifecycle stage where it typically appears and described in plain language. A simple likelihood × impact scoring model lets teams prioritize consistently without heavy tooling, and a ready-to-use risk log template turns the register into an auditable record of owners, controls, and review dates. Each risk is also cross-referenced to established AI governance and security standards, so findings connect directly to existing compliance and assurance work. RSAIRF is designed to be adopted in an afternoon and maintained as a living resource that teams can extend as new risks emerge.
